The execution failed at Step 1f/1g (Word document generation) because the generated summary text did not include at least two of the highest-priority Shipment IDs. While the script likely calculated the totals correctly, the logic for selecting and naming specific Shipment IDs in the Word narrative was insufficient to pass the validation test (`assert mentioned >= 2`). 

Specifically, the test `test_word_summary_content` expects the text to explicitly contain the strings of at least two Shipment IDs that have the highest 'Total Errors' according to the Summary table. Ensure the script identifies these IDs from the summary data and explicitly writes them into the document text.
reasoning: The failure is specific to the content generation logic in the Word document. A reflection level is appropriate to highlight the gap between the generated text and the validation requirements (specifically naming high-priority IDs).
